title: VERY hit or miss
text:
After many months of saying "I'll give it one more try", I cancelled today as this box is too unpredictable for me. I originally became interested in this box after seeing box photos touting brands like Laura Mercier, amorepacific, YSL, caudalie, and oribe. In reality, I got products from NYX, garnier, neutrogena, and olay, sprinkled with a wander beauty mascara and a natasha denona eyeshadow single. Not to say those aren't good offerings, just not what I signed up for.

So many questionable choices, allure. A rollerball (WTF?) of face oil that has instructions on the box explicitly saying to "pump" into your hands and warm it before applying? A full box of Sunday Riley products aka a company that pays their employees to hype products and write positive reviews online under fake names? The same ugly ncLA nail polish in THREE boxes? A NEUTROGENA MAKEUP WIPE?!
I will stick to BeautyFix.
label: neutral
